question: Which Prime Minister was born after India gained independence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Narendra Modi** was born on 17th September 1950, after India gained independence on 15th August 1947.
 
• He became the Prime Minister of India on 26th May 2014.
 
• Modi is the first Prime Minister of India to be born after the country gained independence.
